verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents deploying and running browser agents on its own platform, on a schedule or on demand. It provides hosted browser sessions that scale to thousands of concurrent runs, and a community commenter describes it as a serverless headless browser product. An Optimize tool turns agent runs into reusable Stagehand scripts, and 30+ templates plus price- and listing-tracking use cases fit custom scraping. Missing for 10: explicit docs on deploying arbitrary custom script code (versus agents) as serverless functions, details on the deployment workflow and runtime limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of the deploy feature.
